manifest.source: Complete Rosetta rosetta-groundtruth/1 stream inventory plus type-preserving controlled native transcript journals.

transcript.notes: Primary transcript JSONL. Fixture 1.1.20: USER_INPUT, PLANNER_RESPONSE (optional tool_calls[{name,args}]), RUN_COMMAND (exit_code+content), CHECKPOINT, SYSTEM_MESSAGE. Organic census additionally: CONVERSATION_HISTORY (no content), LIST_DIRECTORY, VIEW_FILE, ERROR_MESSAGE (error+content). Envelope: type, source, status, step_index, created_at.

transcript-full.notes: Sibling of transcript.jsonl. Hook stdin transcriptPath points here. Same record vocabulary as transcript.

transcript-chunks.notes: Chunked copy of transcript.jsonl (00000000.jsonl in 1.1.20, same bytes as the parent file).

conversation-message-index.notes: Map of message-id → bool (read). Resume fixture only. Keys are UUIDs and collapse to <dynamic> in the canonical shape.

conversation-messages.notes: Per-message JSON (id, recipient, sender, priority, timestamp, hideFromUser, content). read.json is a separate stream and must be listed first so it does not merge into this shape.

undelivered-messages.notes: Empty undelivered/ dir created on resume in 1.1.20. Promote when a file appears.

conversation-db.notes: Durable conversation store. One WAL-mode SQLite file per conversation UUID plus -wal/-shm. Schema dump identity is conversations.db (UUID filenames collapsed). Tables: steps (blob payloads), trajectory_meta, gen_metadata, executor_metadata, parent_references, trajectory_metadata_blob, battle_mode_infos. Schema dump: sources/<version>.sqlite-schema.sql.

conversation-summaries.notes: Summary index: conversation_id, title, preview, step_count, workspace_uris, parent_conversation_id, app_data_dir, timestamps.

last-conversations.notes: Launch-cwd → conversation UUID for --continue/-c. Redacted farm keys collapse to <dynamic>.

conversation-metadata.notes: Cache of conversation summaries under conversations.<uuid>. UUID keys collapse to <dynamic>. Written on resume in 1.1.20.

settings.notes: Sparse user settings. Farm writes modelProvider=gemini (required for GEMINI_API_KEY) and toolPermission=always-proceed. Live organic file has been seen with trustedWorkspaces[].

history.notes: Prompt history. Organic keys: display, timestamp (int), workspace, type. Print-mode farm does not write this file.

jetski-state.notes: Protobuf-text jetski runtime state. Inventory only; do not parse.

implicit-protobuf.notes: Unpublished binary protobuf blobs. Inventory only; do not parse. Organic 1.1.12 writes these; print-mode farm does not.

brain-scratch.notes: Per-conversation scratch dir. Created empty in 1.1.20 farm.

user-uploaded.notes: Per-conversation user-upload dir. Created empty in 1.1.20 farm.

scratch.notes: CLI-root scratch dir. Created empty in 1.1.20 farm.

logs.notes: CLI logs — volatile; stripped at harvest.

cli-log.notes: Symlink to the current log/cli-*.log. Stripped at harvest.

presence.notes: Per-conversation presence locks. Stripped at harvest.

last-check.notes: Updater last-check stamp. Stripped at harvest.

changelog-cache.notes: Vendor changelog cache. Stripped at harvest.

bin.notes: Vendor helper binaries (e.g. webm_encoder). Stripped at harvest.

farm:headless-stdout.notes: Headless stream-json stdout — corroboration surface captured by the farm, not part of the agent data root.

claims.notes: Digest-pinned Rosetta record inventory whose occurrence count is non-zero. It proves occurrence; it proves retained shape only for records classified as fixture or observed rather than writer evidence.
Digest-pinned complete Rosetta stream/shape inventory for antigravity@1.1.20; writer-only and zero-occurrence records establish a reviewable contract lead, not runtime occurrence.
